# Launcher and agent command help

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate_cli_reference.py. Don't edit by hand. -->

This page is the `--help` text of every `openadapt` and `openadapt agent`
command, from openadapt 1.17.0, openadapt-flow 2.2.0, openadapt-agent 2.2.1. It's generated from each program's parser, and
CI fails when it differs from those versions. [Commands](cli.md) explains
what each command is for, and [All Flow commands](flow-commands.md) lists
the `openadapt flow` commands. The launcher's research commands
(`capture`, `eval`, `serve`, and `train`) aren't listed.

`openadapt agent ...` runs `openadapt-agent ...`; the help text uses the
second name.

## openadapt

### `openadapt`

```text
Usage: openadapt [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

  OpenAdapt launcher for the openadapt-flow compiler.

  Compile a demonstrated workflow into deterministic local replay. Healthy
  runs make no model calls; configured checks can halt on ambiguity. Native
  and remote substrates use platform-specific extras and permissions;
  training/evaluation commands are research.

  Quick Start (Python 3.10-3.12):
      python -m pip install --upgrade openadapt
      openadapt flow tutorial

  Halt demo:
      openadapt quickstart --break-it

  Manual Demo Lifecycle:
      openadapt flow demo-record --out rec
      openadapt flow compile rec --out bundle --name demo
      openadapt flow lint bundle
      openadapt flow certify bundle --policy permissive
      openadapt flow replay bundle

  Lint lists the demo's coverage gaps. The demo has warnings, so `lint
  --strict` exits 1 on it. The manual demo is runnable but not certified for
  consequential work. Use `openadapt flow tutorial` for the effect-verified
  first run.

  Give an MCP client your compiled workflows:
      openadapt agent serve --bundles DIR --allow-run

Options:
  --version  Show the version and exit.
  --help     Show this message and exit.

Commands:
  flow        Run the canonical demonstration compiler and governed runtime.
  agent       Serve compiled workflows to an MCP client (openadapt-agent).
  capture     Standalone local human GUI capture (optional [capture] extra).
  connect     Connect this computer to the signed-in OpenAdapt Cloud...
  deploy      Check this host and print the safe Flow/Desktop deployment...
  doctor      Check system requirements and dependencies.
  eval        Research: evaluate computer-use models on benchmarks.
  quickstart  Run a verified local tutorial against the bundled synthetic...
  seal        Check an OpenAdapt Seal offline: `openadapt seal verify...
  serve       Research: serve the training dashboard and viewer.
  train       Research: train ML models on captured demonstrations.
  version     Show version information for all packages.
```

### `openadapt agent`

```text
Usage: openadapt agent [OPTIONS]

  Serve compiled workflows to an MCP client (openadapt-agent).

  Every argument passes to openadapt-agent unchanged. Use this form where only
  `openadapt` is on PATH, as after `uv tool install openadapt` or pipx, which
  keep the `openadapt-agent` executable inside the tool's own environment.
  Nothing is written to stdout before the bridge starts, so an MCP client can
  launch this command directly.

Options:
  --help  Show this message and exit.
```

### `openadapt connect`

```text
Usage: openadapt connect [OPTIONS]

  Connect this computer to the signed-in OpenAdapt Cloud workspace.

  The browser creates a five-minute, one-use pairing. This command claims it
  and saves the resulting workspace credential in the OS keychain. It cannot
  execute arbitrary terminal commands or grant browser access to the shell.

Options:
  --pairing TEXT                  Five-minute pairing code from Cloud settings
  --uri TEXT                      Exact openadapt://connect desktop deep link
  --host TEXT                     Cloud origin (default:
                                  https://app.openadapt.ai)
  --device-name TEXT              Name shown for this computer
  --destination-kind [openadapt-managed|customer-managed|local]
                                  Trust class for the pairing destination
  --trusted-host TEXT             Exact allowed customer-managed origin
                                  (repeatable)
  --help                          Show this message and exit.
```

### `openadapt deploy`

```text
Usage: openadapt deploy [OPTIONS]

  Check this host and print the safe Flow/Desktop deployment path.

  This launcher command does not create another runtime or service manager. It
  records no secret value, starts no connector, and does not treat an
  incomplete preflight as a healthy deployment. It composes the installed Flow
  connector, operator console, and repair lifecycle instead.

Options:
  --backend [web|windows|macos|linux|rdp|citrix]
                                  The execution surface that this customer
                                  deployment will use.  [default: web]
  --secret-ref TEXT               Secret reference only: env:NAME or
                                  keychain:service/item. Never pass a secret
                                  value.
  --help                          Show this message and exit.
```

### `openadapt doctor`

```text
Usage: openadapt doctor [OPTIONS]

  Check system requirements and dependencies.

Options:
  --backend [web|windows|macos|linux|rdp|citrix]
                                  Explain setup for one execution surface.
  --help                          Show this message and exit.
```

### `openadapt flow`

```text
Usage: openadapt flow [OPTIONS]

  Run the canonical demonstration compiler and governed runtime.

  Every argument passes to openadapt-flow unchanged. This keeps the launcher
  command list, help, options, validation, and exit codes identical to the
  installed engine version.

Options:
  --help  Show this message and exit.
```

### `openadapt quickstart`

```text
Usage: openadapt quickstart [OPTIONS]

  Run a verified local tutorial against the bundled synthetic app.

  This is the shortest path to a real OpenAdapt run. It uses the bundled
  synthetic tutorial, verifies the write through an independent read-only
  system-of-record interface, keeps every artifact on this computer, and
  enables no model or Cloud call. The output directory is never overwritten.
  Other flags that the engine tutorial accepts (for example --guided or
  --interactive-record) pass through to it unchanged.

Options:
  --out PATH  Directory for the recording, bundle, and run report. Default:
              openadapt-quickstart, suffixed -2, -3, ... when taken.
  --headed    Show the browser while the tutorial runs.
  --break-it  After the verified run, rerun the same certified bundle against
              a fault-injecting backend and watch the engine halt instead of
              trusting the screen.
  --help      Show this message and exit.
```

### `openadapt seal`

```text
Usage: openadapt seal [OPTIONS]

  Check an OpenAdapt Seal offline: `openadapt seal verify <file|url>`.

  Also `openadapt seal keys pin` to pin Cloud's Seal keys after a person
  confirms them. Every argument passes to `openadapt-agent seal` unchanged.

Options:
  --help  Show this message and exit.
```

### `openadapt version`

```text
Usage: openadapt version [OPTIONS]

  Show version information for all packages.

Options:
  --help  Show this message and exit.
```

## openadapt agent

### `openadapt-agent`

```text
usage: openadapt-agent [-h] [--version] {serve,repair,authoring,emit-skill,seal} ...

Your AI agent decides what to enter. OpenAdapt enters it in the app and checks that it saved.
'serve' with no flags starts a sandbox.

positional arguments:
  {serve,repair,authoring,emit-skill,seal}
    serve               Serve workflows to your AI agent over MCP (stdio). With no flags, serve
                        the sandbox.
    repair              Control whether calling agents may help repair halted runs (local only).
    authoring           Hosted authoring mailbox client (ChatGPT.com / Claude.ai). Outbound HTTPS
                        only; not an HTTP listener.
    emit-skill          Write an Agent Skill for one workflow: what it does, its inputs, and how
                        to read the result. No recorded values, step text, or secrets.
    seal                Pin OpenAdapt Cloud's Seal keys and verify a Seal offline.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --version             show program's version number and exit
```

### `openadapt-agent serve`

```text
usage: openadapt-agent serve [-h] [--mode {sandbox,attended,production}] [--bundles BUNDLES]
                             [--sandbox-engine {auto,flow,simulated}] [--authoring]
                             [--windows-agent-url URL] [--remote-window APP]
                             [--remote-window-title TITLE] [--citrix]
                             [--authoring-screens {off,scrubbed,unscrubbed}] [--tutorial]
                             [--allow-run] [--allow-protected-export]
                             [--allow-synthetic-recorded-defaults] [--allow-attended-actions]
                             [--url URL] [--config YAML] [--policy NAME-OR-PATH]
                             [--runs-dir RUNS_DIR] [--timeout SECONDS]
                             [--approval-mode {each_item,problems_only,not_gated}]
                             [--delegate-approvals AGENT_ID] [--allow-url-override]
                             [--flow-cli FLOW_CLI] [--headed] [--allow-model-grounding]
                             [--extra-run-arg ARG] [--repair-access FILE] [--repair-dir DIR]
                             [--hold-on-halt SECONDS]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --mode {sandbox,attended,production}
                        sandbox (default with no --bundles): one synthetic workflow that shows
                        every result. production: run the compiled workflows in --bundles.
                        attended: production plus decisions on paused runs by a person at this
                        computer. --bundles without --mode stays read-only.
  --bundles BUNDLES     Bundle directory: either one compiled bundle, or a directory whose
                        immediate subdirectories are bundles. Needed for --mode production and
                        --mode attended.
  --sandbox-engine {auto,flow,simulated}
                        Advanced. flow drives the synthetic app in a hidden browser (needs the
                        tutorial extra); simulated returns the same results without opening it.
                        auto picks flow when it can.
  --authoring           Register first-demo authoring tools over local stdio: observe,
                        start_record, click, halt. Local Claude Code path is the first authoring
                        UI. Pass --url --headed to pin Playwright Chromium with empty cookies;
                        pause_for_input is how a person signs in there. --url is not the Chrome
                        window you already signed into. Omit --url to pin a unique frontmost
                        Chrome window after login (macOS; no DOM identity). Local stdio may also
                        type through the recorder; hosted MCP remains pause-only. Does not enable
                        run tools. This process stays stdio and must not be served over HTTP.
  --windows-agent-url URL
                        With --authoring: drive a native Windows app through the Flow Windows
                        agent server running on the Windows computer (for example
                        http://localhost:5001, or an SSH-forwarded port from another computer).
                        The agent's input goes through the same synthetic-input path replay uses.
                        The token comes from OAFLOW_AGENT_TOKEN.
  --remote-window APP   With --authoring: drive the RDP or Citrix session shown in this local
                        client window (app name, for example 'Microsoft Remote Desktop'). Screen-
                        only: the agent clicks pixels and presses keys.
  --remote-window-title TITLE
                        With --remote-window or --citrix: pick one window by its title.
  --citrix              With --authoring: drive the local Citrix Workspace window (--remote-window
                        overrides the app name). Screen-only.
  --authoring-screens {off,scrubbed,unscrubbed}
                        With --authoring: let the agent see the pinned window through the screen
                        tool, so it can drive a native Windows app or a remote session from
                        pixels. scrubbed removes identifiers first and shares nothing if that
                        fails. Default off.
  --tutorial            Older name for --mode sandbox. Synthetic only. Cannot be combined with
                        --bundles, --url, or --config.
  --allow-run           Older name for --mode production (with --bundles) or --mode sandbox
                        (without). Without a mode or this flag, --bundles stays read-only.
  --allow-protected-export
                        DANGER: export raw workflow labels, recorded values, intents, local paths,
                        reports, stdout, stderr, and exception detail to the MCP client. Off by
                        default; enable only for an explicitly trusted local client inside the
                        protected data boundary.
  --allow-synthetic-recorded-defaults
                        DEMO ONLY: let omitted workflow parameters reuse recorded values. Use only
                        with synthetic demonstrations; production requires every declared
                        parameter so a run cannot silently target the recorded customer or record.
  --allow-attended-actions
                        Part of --mode attended. Register governed Reject/Teach/Escalate tools for
                        signed durable pauses. With --config, also register Continue/Skip through
                        Flow's deployment-bound live verifier and deterministic resume path.
  --url URL             Target app URL passed to every `openadapt-flow run` (operator-fixed)
  --config YAML         Deployment config YAML forwarded to `openadapt-flow run --config`
  --policy NAME-OR-PATH
                        Certifying policy forwarded to `openadapt-flow run --policy` and used by
                        get_workflow's certification check
  --runs-dir RUNS_DIR   Directory for run records and evidence (default:
                        $OPENADAPT_AGENT_RUNS_DIR, else ~/.openadapt/runs; the sandbox uses
                        ~/.openadapt/agent-sandbox). Never relative to the folder the client
                        starts the server in.
  --timeout SECONDS     Per-call timeout for each governed run (default: 600)
  --approval-mode {each_item,problems_only,not_gated}
                        Per-save approval passed to every `openadapt-flow run`. Unset (the
                        default): Flow decides, and under the Standard and Regulated profiles each
                        save waits for approval (each_item); a run waiting for that approval
                        reports needs_review. not_gated turns the pause off for every run this
                        server starts, and each run's result and Flow's report record that.
                        Callers can't change it.
  --delegate-approvals AGENT_ID
                        Let the calling agent answer saves that wait for an approval, as the
                        opaque id AGENT_ID (for example agent:intake-bot). Adds the
                        list_approval_requests and answer_approval_request tools. Flow accepts the
                        agent's answer only where the run's approver policy (openadapt-flow run
                        --approver-policy) allows an agent for that step; by default only a person
                        may answer. Flow records the agent as the approver.
  --allow-url-override  Permit MCP callers to pass a per-call `url` argument (default: the target
                        URL is fixed by --url/--config at server start)
  --flow-cli FLOW_CLI   Command used to invoke the flow CLI (default: this interpreter's `python
                        -m openadapt_flow`, so the flow installed alongside this server is always
                        the one that runs); may contain spaces, e.g. 'openadapt-flow'
  --headed              Keep a deployment-configured attended web session visible to the local
                        operator (required for web Continue/Skip).
  --allow-model-grounding
                        Explicit CLI opt-in for configured off-box model grounding. A deployment
                        config may also opt in; otherwise verification remains local.
  --extra-run-arg ARG   Extra argument appended to every `openadapt-flow run` invocation
                        (repeatable; operator-fixed, e.g. --extra-run-arg=--allow-unencrypted for
                        a demo bundle)
  --repair-access FILE  Screen access setting for repairs, written by `openadapt-agent repair
                        access`. Without it, halted runs still return needs_repair but no screens,
                        and teach_repair is not offered.
  --repair-dir DIR      Where repair tokens, approvals, and candidates live (default
                        RUNS_DIR/.repair).
  --hold-on-halt SECONDS
                        With --repair-access, keep a halted browser run's page open this long so
                        teach_repair acts on it (default 300; 0 turns it off).
```

### `openadapt-agent repair`

```text
usage: openadapt-agent repair [-h] {access,approve-screen} ...

positional arguments:
  {access,approve-screen}
    access              Set screen access for repairs for one workflow or the whole organization.
    approve-screen      Look at the exact screen a calling agent would get for one repair, and
                        approve it.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
```

### `openadapt-agent repair access`

```text
usage: openadapt-agent repair access [-h] (--workflow WORKFLOW | --org) --screens
                                     {off,scrubbed_only,ask_each_time,allow_unscrubbed} --by BY
                                     --file FILE

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --workflow WORKFLOW   Workflow name from list_workflows
  --org                 Default for every workflow
  --screens {off,scrubbed_only,ask_each_time,allow_unscrubbed}
  --by BY               Your name, recorded with the setting
  --file FILE           The --repair-access file
```

### `openadapt-agent repair approve-screen`

```text
usage: openadapt-agent repair approve-screen [-h] --by BY --repair-access FILE --repair-dir DIR
                                             token_id

positional arguments:
  token_id              token_id from the needs_repair result

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --by BY               Your name, recorded with the approval
  --repair-access FILE
  --repair-dir DIR
```

### `openadapt-agent authoring`

```text
usage: openadapt-agent authoring [-h] {connect} ...

positional arguments:
  {connect}
    connect   Claim an openadapt://runner link or pack URL, poll wait=0, and prompt Allow per chat
              account

options:
  -h, --help  show this help message and exit
```

### `openadapt-agent authoring connect`

```text
usage: openadapt-agent authoring connect [-h] [--url URL] [--headed] target

Claim an openadapt://runner link or pack URL, poll wait=0, and prompt Allow per chat account.
Overlay chrome stays Desktop-only. Continue uses record_observed; it does not type secrets. This
process only makes outbound HTTPS.

positional arguments:
  target      openadapt://runner?pack=…&bind=oab_…&origin=https://openadapt.ai or
              https://openadapt.ai/j/{id} (bind required to claim)

options:
  -h, --help  show this help message and exit
  --url URL   Launch Playwright Chromium with empty cookies at this URL. Not the browser you are
              already signed into.
  --headed    Keep the Playwright window visible (required to sign in in the app).
```

### `openadapt-agent emit-skill`

```text
usage: openadapt-agent emit-skill [-h] --out OUT [--include-bundle] bundle

positional arguments:
  bundle            Workflow bundle directory

options:
  -h, --help        show this help message and exit
  --out OUT         Parent directory for the skill folder
  --include-bundle  Also copy the compiled bundle next to SKILL.md. The copy is protected workflow
                    data; install it only where that data may live.
```

### `openadapt-agent seal`

```text
usage: openadapt-agent seal [-h] {verify,keys} ...

positional arguments:
  {verify,keys}
    verify       Check a Seal (receipt, run report, or webhook JSON).
    keys         Pin or show the Cloud Seal keys this computer trusts.

options:
  -h, --help     show this help message and exit
```

### `openadapt-agent seal verify`

```text
usage: openadapt-agent seal verify [-h] [--keys KEYS] [--json] target

positional arguments:
  target       Path, https:// URL, or - for stdin

options:
  -h, --help   show this help message and exit
  --keys KEYS  Pinned key file (default: your pinned keys)
  --json       Print the verdict as JSON
```

### `openadapt-agent seal keys`

```text
usage: openadapt-agent seal keys [-h] {pin,show} ...

positional arguments:
  {pin,show}
    pin       Fetch /api/public/seal-keys and pin new keys after a person confirms each one.
    show      List pinned keys with fingerprints.

options:
  -h, --help  show this help message and exit
```

### `openadapt-agent seal keys pin`

```text
usage: openadapt-agent seal keys pin [-h] [--url URL] [--path PATH] [--confirm KEY_ID]

options:
  -h, --help        show this help message and exit
  --url URL         Key registry URL (default https://app.openadapt.ai/api/public/seal-keys)
  --path PATH       Pinned key file (default ~/.openadapt/seal-keys.json)
  --confirm KEY_ID  Trust this key id without a prompt, after checking its fingerprint out of
                    band. Repeatable.
```

### `openadapt-agent seal keys show`

```text
usage: openadapt-agent seal keys show [-h] [--path PATH]

options:
  -h, --help   show this help message and exit
  --path PATH
```
